svg.aria-label: Heartbeat-based presence with a 30-second threshold. Top: the client sends a heartbeat every 5 seconds, loses its connection from about 12 to 23 seconds, then resumes; it never goes 30 seconds without a heartbeat, so the status stays online. Bottom: heartbeats stop after 10 seconds, and at 40 seconds (30 seconds later) the status changes to offline.
svg.title: Heartbeat presence
